decision_points.question: which regression model / outcome family is used to estimate the effect?
decision_points.why_rival: each picks one functional form for the primary model (logistic, LPM, Poisson, OLS, probit, mixed); an analyst runs one as the main estimator

decision_points.question: how are the model's standard errors estimated?
decision_points.why_rival: each computes uncertainty a different way (player-clustered, referee-clustered, HC1 robust, closed-form binomial), a single mutually-exclusive choice; these co-occur with plain model-family options, confirming they are a distinct slot

decision_points.question: how are records with missing values handled?
decision_points.why_rival: impute-and-keep vs listwise deletion (on covariates vs on a broad variable set) each disposes of incomplete records a different, mutually-exclusive way

decision_points.question: which covariates does the primary model adjust for (if any)?
decision_points.why_rival: each specifies the adjustment set for the primary model — no covariates/crude vs an expanded physical-style set vs position+league; the analyst settles on one primary specification

decision_points.question: how is referee bias controlled for in the model?
decision_points.why_rival: referee bias is handled by including it as a covariate (one measure or both meanIAT+meanExp) or, instead, absorbed via referee fixed effects — the 'swap for fixed effects' wording marks these as direct alternatives

decision_points.question: how is the skin-tone exposure operationalized?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether skin tone enters continuous or dichotomized at a cut-point (here 0.125)

decision_points.question: are the covariates standardized/z-scored before entering the model?
decision_points.why_rival: both settle the scaling of covariates going into the regression

decision_points.question: how is the exposure entered relative to the covariates (hierarchical block structure)?
decision_points.why_rival: settles the entry/blocking scheme for the focal predictor and controls

decision_points.question: is multicollinearity among covariates diagnosed?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether a VIF collinearity check is run

decision_points.question: is covariate balance across exposure groups checked?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether a balance/characterization table by exposure is produced

decision_points.question: how is the model estimated/fit?
decision_points.why_rival: settles the fitting procedure (maximum likelihood) for the adjusted model

decision_points.question: how are categorical covariates encoded before modeling?
decision_points.why_rival: settles the pre-modeling encoding (categorical dtype / dummy-coding) of covariates

decision_points.question: are interaction terms included in the model?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether the effect model carries interactions with a varying focal predictor

decision_points.question: what secondary/sensitivity regression is fit alongside the primary model?
decision_points.why_rival: each is a robustness refit choosing what to check — mirror primary covariates, swap logistic for the LPM, or report the exponentiated OR

decision_points.question: which model results are reported/headlined?
decision_points.why_rival: settles what is surfaced in the write-up (exposure coefficient only, omitting covariates)
